title: The Plutarchian
author: Andrea Marini
description:
If you want history without the shortcuts, this is for you.
The Plutarchian takes you deep into Rome, the ancient Mediterranean, medieval Europe, Renaissance Italy, and the people and systems that shaped them. Emperors, republics, cities, wars, conspiracies, heresies, trials, armies, institutions, religion, logistics: each episode follows the evidence as far as it can go.
Here, history is not reduced to trivia, easy morals, or a handful of famous names. You get the chronology, the sources, the political pressures, the material realities, and the arguments historians still disagree about.
Some episodes follow a single life. Others reconstruct a crisis, a city, a war, or a transformation that took generations to unfold. The goal is always the same: to leave you with a clearer picture of how the past actually worked.
If you like long-form history with depth, detail, and no fear of complexity, welcome to The Plutarchian.
Written and narrated by historian Andrea Marini.
New episodes and selected works from the archive are released regularly. Illustrated versions are available on YouTube at The Plutarchian.

This podcast was created to bring real discussions to the table about the issues shaping our communities, our families, and the future of California. From crime and public safety to agriculture, water, addiction, leadership, and the changing culture of our state, we take an honest look at the challenges facing everyday people across the Valley.

As sheriff, I’ve spent a lifetime serving communities, standing beside victims, supporting families, and witnessing both the struggles and the strength that define the people of this region. But this podcast goes beyond the badge. Golden State Justice is about bringing together voices from every corner of our communities — law enforcement, farmers, teachers, first responders, faith leaders, business owners, parents, and the people living these realities every day.

Here, we’ll talk about the fentanyl crisis impacting our youth, the pressures facing rural communities, major cases that shaped California, leadership during difficult times, and the policies that affect life in the Central Valley. We’ll also share stories of resilience, service, recovery, and hope — because despite the challenges, the spirit of the Valley remains strong.

This is not about politics for the sake of division. It’s about truth, accountability, public safety, and protecting the values that matter most to our communities.

Whether you live in a small farming town, a growing city, or anywhere across California, Golden State Justice is your place for authentic conversations about the people, the problems, and the pursuit of justice in the Golden State.

Welcome to the conversation. Welcome to Golden State Justice.

title: Food For The Soul

Food For The Soul is your private pocket-sized pep talk for the moments when life, leadership, business and ambition feel like a lot.
Hosted by Ally Nitschke, award winning entrepreneur, keynote speaker and author. This podcast is designed for high-performing women who are leading, building, carrying, creating, growing and quietly wondering when they get to exhale.
These are short, powerful episodes to help you come back to yourself, find your fire again and remember who you are underneath the pressure, the people-pleasing, the proving and the constant pull to be everything for everyone.
Food For The Soul is not another podcast telling you to do more, be more, push harder or optimise every part of your life.
It is the voice in your ear before the meeting, the reset after the hard conversation, the reminder before you undercharge, the permission slip when you are exhausted, and the steadying hand on your shoulder when you are about to shrink, silence yourself or forget your own power.
Each episode is a short, soulful and practical pep talk designed to meet you in real-life moments: when your confidence takes a hit, when you are tired of being the strong one, when you need to hold a boundary, when you are comparing yourself to everyone else, when you are ready to stop over-explaining, when you want to be seen, when you need to ask for the money, when you are stepping into a bigger room, and when you are becoming the next version of yourself.
This show is for executive women, entrepreneur women, founders, leaders, speakers, consultants, mothers, creatives and ambitious women who are done performing 'fine' and ready to return to themselves.
You will find episodes on courage, confidence, self-trust, boundaries, money, worth, visibility, leadership, emotional resilience, nervous system regulation, courageous conversations and coming back to your fire.
Think of it as food for the woman behind the title, the business, the role, the responsibilities and the expectations.
Because you are not too much. You are not behind. You are not here to shrink. You are not required to hold everything together at the expense of yourself.
You are allowed to lead, receive, rise, rest, want more, take up space and come home to the woman you are becoming.
Food For The Soul is here to help you return to you, one powerful pep talk at a time.

title: The Psychology Of Selling With Marco Fernandes

description:
Most people who try to sell high-ticket products and services fail at it, and almost none of them understand why. This show fixes that.
Hosted by Marco Fernandes, one of the most experienced closers in the world, this is a no-nonsense podcast about how high-ticket selling actually works. Not theory. Not hype. The real thing, from a man who has spent 39 years doing it and has personally closed over $200 million in sales.
Marco has sold at every level there is. He started as a teenager on the doorsteps and in the boiler rooms, cold-closed the biggest supermarket chains in the country, and built and trained sales teams that generated over $100 million in a single year. He has turned ordinary salespeople into serious earners, transformed entire retail operations, and helped business owners replace weak, inconsistent selling with a system that actually runs. On this show, he hands all of it to you.
Every episode breaks down a real piece of the craft: what closing genuinely is (service, not pressure), the mindset that separates the closers who win from the ones who fold, how to read a buyer and hear what they are really telling you, and the exact 10-step process Marco has used to close deals of every size. 
Along the way he tells the true stories behind the numbers, from record-breaking retail floors to 10 million kilos of fish sold through Tesco, Sainsbury's, Asda and Morrisons off the back of a single cold call.
Whoever you are, there is something here for you. If you run a business and you know your sales are the thing holding your growth back, you will learn what world-class selling looks like and how to get it. If you lead a sales team, you will get a proven method you can train into your people. And if you want to become a high-ticket closer and build a real career, you will learn the craft from someone who has mastered it and trained hundreds of others.
No fluff. No magic bullets. No get-rich-quick nonsense. Just the honest mechanics of how people decide to buy, and how to get genuinely good at helping them do it.
Want to go further? If you would like to talk to our team about transforming the sales in your business, book a free discovery call here: https://tinyurl.com/systemisediscovery
Subscribe now, and let's turn your selling into something that actually performs.

title: Shed Talk with Kevin Halliday
author: Kevin Halliday
description:
Welcome to "Shed Talk with Kevin Halliday," where we embark on a riveting journey through the life and wisdom of a true force of nature. Kevin Halliday's story is a testament to the boundless potential of the human spirit, and in this podcast, he takes us on a remarkable adventure filled with inspiration, entrepreneurship, and the pursuit of excellence.


Kevin's journey is anything but ordinary. He didn't follow a linear path to success; he carved his own way through the business world, leaving a trail of innovation and achievement in his wake. It all began with his Calgary-based brick-and-mortar company, Spindle, Stairs & Railings. From crafting custom railings to undertaking ambitious commercial projects, Kevin's business became synonymous with quality and craftsmanship.

But Kevin is more than just a successful entrepreneur; he's a multifaceted individual with a passion for exploration and a knack for seizing opportunities. He's an author, with his latest publication, "The Art of Spindle, Stairs & Railings," showcasing his expertise and creative flair. Kevin is also an investor, backing ventures like Brix + Barrel and the Rooftop YYC, two thriving establishments in Calgary's vibrant dining scene. In recognition of his outstanding contributions, he was named one of the "Top 40 Under 40" and earned a spot as an Entrepreneur of the Year finalist in 2010.


Now, let's dive into what makes "Shed Talks with Kevin Halliday" an unmissable podcast:


1. Unparalleled Insights: In each episode, Kevin invites guests to join him in the shed, where they engage in candid conversations that transcend the ordinary. These discussions are a treasure trove of insights, revelations, and thought-provoking ideas that will expand your horizons.

2. The Curiosity Quotient: Kevin Halliday is a firm believer in the power of curiosity. He challenges you to ask yourself, "When was the last time you had curiosity in your head?" Shed Talk encourages you to embrace curiosity, sparking the creative flames within you and inspiring you to explore uncharted territory.

3. Breaking Barriers: Just as Kevin diversified his career from Spindle, Stairs & Railings to investments in dining and beyond, Shed Talk breaks through conventional boundaries. This podcast transcends industries and topics, diving headfirst into the unknown, the intriguing, and the transformative.

4. The Things You Know You Don't Know: Shed Talk delves into those enigmatic areas of knowledge—the things you know you don't know. Kevin Halliday is your guide on this intellectual journey, unraveling mysteries, and uncovering hidden gems of wisdom.

5. A Force of Nature: Kevin Halliday's life is a testament to resilience, adaptability, and relentless pursuit of excellence. Whether it's mastering the art of business, investing in thriving ventures, or conquering bodybuilding to win a Gold Medal in Master's Men's Bodybuilding, Kevin embodies the spirit of venturing beyond boundaries.

6. Great Conversations: At its heart, "Shed Talk with Kevin Halliday" is an interview show, a place where great conversations come to life. Kevin's guests bring their unique perspectives and experiences to the shed, creating dialogues that are both enlightening and captivating.

Join us on this exhilarating ride as we explore the extraordinary life and wisdom of Kevin Halliday. "Shed Talk with Kevin Halliday" isn't just a podcast; it's an invitation to unleash your curiosity, challenge the status quo, and pursue excellence in every aspect of your life.

Remember, "you don't know what you know till you know." And with Shed Talk, you're about to discover a world of knowledge, inspiration, and limitless possibilities.

Hosted by author and creator Julie Bolejack, the show explores reinvention, purpose, resilience, creativity, relationships, work, aging, retirement and the wonderfully imperfect process of figuring out what comes next.

Through honest solo conversations, practical ideas, personal stories, and interviews with fascinating people who have reinvented themselves, Julie challenges the idea that our most interesting years are behind us.

You don’t have to erase everything you’ve been to become something new. Your experience isn’t baggage—it’s your foundation.

Whether you're navigating retirement or life after a long career, a career change, an empty nest, loss, changing relationships, a long-delayed dream, or simply hearing that little voice asking, “Now what?”—you belong here.

Because retirement from a career doesn’t mean retirement from purpose, curiosity, creativity, or possibility.

You are Not Done Yet.

title: Tremor & Parkinson's Surgery Explained with Dr. Wu
author: Chengyuan
description:
Parkinson's meds stopped working like they used to? Tremor making it hard to write, eat, or hold a cup steady? You're not stuck choosing between "wait it out" and "risky brain surgery." 


Dr. Chengyuan Wu is a board certified neurosurgeon who performs single-day, asleep, robot-assisted deep brain stimulation (DBS) for Parkinson's disease and essential tremor, plus incisionless focused ultrasound for tremor and surgery for drug-resistant epilepsy. 


After 2,500+ surgeries, he breaks down what DBS actually involves, who qualifies, what recovery looks like, and why modern DBS carries a lower 30-day complication rate than a hip or knee replacement. 


No scare tactics, no "last resort" thinking. Just clear answers so you can make an informed choice about getting your function back. New episodes on Parkinson's, tremor, and epilepsy surgery weekly.

title: No Plan Survives
author: Benjie Hughes & Mike Carpenter
description:
No Plan Survives is about what happens when our business vision crashes into our business reality – and the new things we create as a result.

This is a limited series: Two entrepreneurs, five days, five topics. Each day we each bring one story from our business journeys, told in three acts:

·         What was your plan?

·         How did reality wreck it?

·         What was born as a result?


Then we interrogate those stories – and each other.


This is a business show that feels more “beer at five” than “Monday morning coffee.” You might hear our tips and frameworks, but it’s not about the frameworks. It’s about what happens when theory crashes into practice – and transforms.


And we get transformed, too.


Hosts:

·         Benjie Hughes is the founder of Hopeless Marketing and a classic “Act 1” builder: In his 20s he started a music business from scratch, grew it, scaled it, exited it. Now he’s in his 40s and starting from scratch again.

·         Mike Carpenter is the owner and CEO at RH Adhesives and a classic “Act 2” builder: He took over an existing manufacturer with a 75-year legacy and then doubled its business. Now he’s building software  tools that might just find a market beyond his own shop’s needs.


They say no plan survives first contact with the enemy. That’s true in all this week’s topics: Vision, revenue, marketing, data and uncertainty.


But it’s also true that when plans die, new things rise up to take their place.


Find and follow Mike and Benjie at noplan.show.

Join ThruDark Co-Founder and former UK Special Forces Operator Anthony 'Staz' Stazicker CGC as he joins a host of inspiring individuals for a hike, using the power of the great outdoors to get people talking about the things that matter.


About ThruDark


ThruDark is a British high-performance clothing brand founded by former UK Special Forces operators Anthony "Staz" Stazicker CGC and Louis Tinsley. Between them, they spent 27 years in the British military, 18 of those in the Special Boat Service, working as snipers, demolition experts and surveillance specialists. ThruDark launched in May 2018 at Bremont's London HQ, with a launch film narrated by actor Tom Hardy. Its first product, a bespoke Summit Suit, was worn for the fastest ascent of the world's 14 highest peaks and later on the summit of Everest. In May 2025, Staz completed a fastest known time on Mission: Everest, travelling from London to the summit and back in seven days, a world first. Every product since has been designed, developed and tested personally by its founders.

Eternal Flame Physics examines structure, fields, pressure, pathways, trajectories, perception, the physical body, anomalous activity, time, continuity, environments, and the larger external architecture humanity is living within.

This is not New Age, spiritual, metaphysical, religious, or another belief system or paradigm. Eternal Flame Physics is anti-paradigm. It strips away mythology, symbolism, inherited explanations, and render-based interpretations in order to expose the mechanics underneath them. The experience is separated from the story built around it. The perception is separated from the structure producing it. The rendered event becomes evidence rather than the beginning of the explanation.

The work also maintains the foundational distinction between the Eternal and the external: the Eternal is original and unmoving; the external is movement-based architecture. Physical reality is render within that larger external condition, not the totality or source of reality itself.

Episodes move freely through the body of work rather than following a fixed syllabus. One subject, one question, one mechanic—and then the structure is followed wherever it leads.

No video. No visual performance. Just voice, Flame tone, and Eternal Flame Physics spoken in real time.

title: INVISIBLE LOSS | DNA Test, Secrets, Father, Who Am I, Acceptance, Intrusive Thoughts
author: latekiabush
description:
Have you ever discovered a truth that made you question everything about your life?

Have you ever felt like the ground beneath you shifted… but everyone around you kept saying, “nothing has changed”?

Do you find yourself asking:
 Who am I now?
 Where do I belong?
 Was any of it real?

Have you learned that the man who raised you is not your biological father… and now you’re carrying a kind of pain you don’t even have words for?

A quiet grief.
 An identity you can’t quite hold onto.
 A story that no longer fits.

And somehow… you’re still expected to cook dinner, answer texts, show up for your kids, and act like your entire identity didn’t just get flipped upside down.

(Meanwhile, inside… it’s giving fire, tornado, hailstorm, chaos, and who even am I all at the same time.)

If this is you—you’re not imagining it.
 And you’re definitely not alone.

This is Invisible Loss.

What you’re really wanting (even if you haven’t said it out loud):

You want to know the truth… fully.
 You want to feel acknowledged and accepted.
 You want to see yourself in someone—to finally recognize where you come from.
 You want to feel whole again.

And more than anything…

You want peace.
 Not perfect answers.
 Not a perfectly tied-up story.

Just… peace in your own mind and body again.

What you’ll find here:

This podcast is a space where your experience is finally named—and where you’re not told to “just move on.”

We talk about:

  • The emotional impact of DNA discoveries and hidden family truths
  • The loss of a father you still love
  • The weight of secrets, silence, and betrayal
  • Intrusive thoughts and identity confusion
  • Feeling like a stranger in your own life

But we also move toward something:

Here, you’ll learn how to:

  • Reclaim your identity—even when your story has changed
  • Process the grief that no one else sees
  • Quiet the mental spiral and intrusive thoughts
    • Find peace without needing every answer
    • Reconnect with yourself—your voice, your truth, your sense of belonging

    Because healing doesn’t come from pretending it didn’t happen…
     it comes from finally facing what was hidden—and choosing yourself anyway.

    I’m Latekia Bush — a mother and woman who once believed I knew exactly where I came from… until I didn’t.

    Like many of you, I discovered that the man who raised me was not my biological father. And in that moment, everything shifted. My identity, my past, how I saw myself—everything.

    I tried to move on like nothing changed.
     I searched for answers outside of myself.
     I wanted closure… clarity… something that would make it all make sense.

    But that didn’t bring me peace.

    What did?

    Allowing myself to feel the loss.
     To name what was true.
     To stop minimizing the pain just because others couldn’t see it.

    And then… something harder.

    I had to accept my reality.
     Not the version I wished it could be.
     Not the version that made it easier to hold onto what I thought I had…

    But the truth.

    And I had to let it go.

    Not like it didn’t matter—
     but in a way that stopped it from holding me hostage.

    Because peace didn’t come from figuring everything out.

    It came when I stopped fighting what was…
     and allowed myself to live forward anyway.

    And slowly…
     I began rebuilding who I am from the inside out.

    This podcast is for women—often mothers, often “Daddy’s girls”—who grew up believing they had a complete story… only to discover there was more.

    More truth.
     More questions.
     More to heal.

    If you’ve ever felt like an outsider in your own life…
     like something doesn’t quite fit anymore…
     like you’re searching for yourself while still trying to hold everything else together…

    You belong here.

    Because even when the truth changes your story…
     you still get to reclaim who you are becoming.

description:
CitasAlma is for people who'd rather send one thoughtful message than spend an evening scrolling — an online dating platform that puts soulful, intentional conversation at the center of how people connect.

What does daily use on CitasAlma actually look like? Browsing member profiles that feel worth reading, following a newsfeed, returning to saved message drafts before sending, using one-tap interest markers, following members, relying on icebreakers when the first message isn't coming easily, and filtering search results to find people worth investing a considered first message in. Photos can be shared in chat once a conversation has some soul behind it.

Support is reachable 24/7, with straightforward questions typically answered within a day and more complex ones resolved within a few business days.

Joining CitasAlma takes a free sign-up and a profile — nothing more elaborate than that. The platform lives on a mobile website, so there's nothing to install. Verification goes through an independent third-party process, but it's there for anyone who wants it before committing time to a conversation.

For people who think one real conversation is worth a hundred superficial ones — CitasAlma is built for that instinct.

title: Leading Disruption with Charlene Li
author: Charlene  Li
description:
When was the last time you did something at work that genuinely scared you?
Not "this meeting is uncomfortable" scared. I mean the kind where you didn't know if you were going to get it right. Where the ground felt unsteady. Where every smart, experienced part of you said, “This might not work.”
If you can remember that moment, you know exactly what leading disruption feels like.
If you can't, that's actually the more important signal.
I'm Charlene Li. I'm a strategist and author, and I've spent my career studying what it takes to lead through change. Not the comfortable type of change. We’re talking about real, disruptive change. The kind of change that creates entirely new value while destroying the old at the same time.
This podcast is called Leading Disruption. And it exists because disruption isn't coming; it's here. AI. Organizational change. The speed at which everything is moving. Leaders are being asked to operate in conditions they have never trained for.
Every week, I'm going to give you the frameworks, the honesty, and the real-world perspective you need, not just to survive what's ahead, but to lead it. On your terms.
We're going to talk about why your body is wired to avoid disruption and why running toward it anyway is the only move that works. We're going to get specific about AI: what the right questions are, why most leaders are asking the wrong ones, and what it takes to create real value rather than empty activity. And we're going to go beyond AI too, because disruption stay still. 
If your palms are a little sweaty and your stomach is churning, good. That means you're doing it right.
I'm Charlene Li. This is Leading Disruption.

And prepare yourself for stories that might make you look over your shoulder.

Subscribe to Night Time Spooks and join us as we explore the stories that are difficult to explain and even harder to forget.

Because once the lights go out...

the night has its own stories to tell.

Dark stories. Strange encounters. Fear after midnight.

قعدة روقان بودكاست اجتماعي إنساني يناقش العلاقات، المشاعر، الأمان النفسي، والوعي الذاتي

استطاع بودكاست قعدة روقان أن يحجز مكانةً استثنائية في المشهد الصوتي العالمي، حيث يُصنف اليوم ضمن أفضل 3% من البودكاست عالمياً وفقاً لمنصة PodSEO وكبرى منصات التحليل الدولية.

​هذا النجاح لم يتوقف عند أرقام الاستماع، بل تم اختيار محتوى "قعدة روقان" ليُحفظ ويُسجل ضمن Archive.org (أرشيف الإنترنت العالمي) كمحتوى وتراث ثقافي إنساني؛ لضمان بقاء هذه الرسالة النفسية والاجتماعية خالدة للأجيال القادمة، كجزء من الذاكرة الرقمية التي تسعى لنشر الوعي النفسي باللغة العربية.

​للتواصل

title: بداية أخرى 🌷
author: Neama elkumy( مرشدة الوعي النفسي والتطوير الذاتي وإدارةالعلاقات)
description:
لأن الهدوء ليس نهاية الحكاية.. من صناع بودكاست "قعدة روقان"، نبدأ معًا رحلة تستحق العودة في "بداية أخرى

 

مرحبًا بك في بداية أخرى 🌷 مساحة هادئة لاستكشاف العالم الداخلي للإنسان، حيث نغوص في علم النفس، والسلوك البشري، والعلاقات، والذكاء العاطفي، والتعافي النفسي، وتطوير الذات، والعقلية المالية، وبناء العلامة الشخصية الفكرية، واتخاذ القرارات، وتحقيق الأهداف.

إذا كنت تبحث عن فهم أعمق لنفسك، ولماذا تفكر وتشعر وتتصرف بالطريقة التي تفعلها، فستجد هنا حلقات تناقش الأفكار من منظور إنساني وعملي، بعيدًا عن التعقيد الأكاديمي، وبأسلوب هادئ يجمع بين التأمل والتحليل.

ستكتشف موضوعات مثل:

• علم النفس والسلوك الإنساني.

• العلاقات الصحية والذكاء العاطفي.

• التعافي من التجارب المؤلمة.

• فهم أنماط التفكير والعقليات المختلفة.

• العقلية المالية وإدارة الحياة.

• بناء براند فكري وشخصية مؤثرة.

• اتخاذ القرارات والتعامل مع التغيير.

• تحقيق الأحلام والنمو الشخصي.

• الوعي بالذات وفهم الدوافع الداخلية.

| بداي أخرى رحلة لفهم الإنسان من الداخل، وتحويل الأفكار إلى وعي، والوعي إلى حياة أكثر اتزانًا وعمقًا.

title: The Yes Capacity
author: Garrett Case
description: Hey I'm Garrett. On this show, we explore how to build a life of financial independence and radical time freedom, not for the sake of "early retirement," but for the sake of living out our calling as Christians. If you want to learn how to take your family to the zoo on a Tuesday morning and say a radical "YES" to God’s promptings without checking your bank account first, you’re in the right place. New episodes weekly!

title: UNTOLD Adoption Stories - By Positive Choice Adoption
author: Positive Choice Adoption
description: UNTOLD Adoption Stories is a platform for people to share their stories of how adoption has positively impacted their lives. Presented by Positive Choice Adoption, UNTOLD Adoption Stories wants to exemplify the love that adoption showcases to those who are experiencing an unwanted pregnancy or those who know someone who is going through one. Join us to hear amazing stories from people who have been touched by adoption.

The Clooless Podcast!

Episodes Every Tuesday

title: RPPS Podcast
author: Redwood Park PS
description:
🎧 Get ready to be immersed in Redwood PS! 
🍿 Grab your popcorn, turn up the volume and join us for the ride as we capture our learning journey. This is our Year 4/5 digital learning journal, where you'll hear from the voices of our students, discover what we're learning in class and celebrate the amazing things happening at our school. 
We work hard, have fun and live our values of Respect, Teamwork, Persistence and Pride every day… because it's always a great day at Redwood Park Primary School! ⭐🎙️

title: Future of Work: Australia - A Workday Podcast
author: futureofworkaustralia
description:
How are Australian organisations building a future where people and AI genuinely work better together?

The Future of Work: Australia podcast brings together C-suite executives, AI innovators and industry pioneers for straight-talking conversations about the opportunities and challenges reshaping work.

From decision-making and leadership to trust and wellbeing, we unpack real-world lessons, local perspectives and practical ideas for navigating the new work day, right here in Australia.

New episodes arrive monthly. Subscribe to join the conversation and hear from the leaders shaping the future of work.

title: To Tell You the Truth Podcast
author: Caroline Cook
description:
This is the podcast you listen to when you’re done playing it safe.
Hosted by Caroline Cook, award-winning entrepreneur, songwriter, artist and your Gay Aunt from the internet, To Tell You the Truth, is a weekly dose of honest conversations with fascinating people who are actually going for it.
Expect big ideas, wild stories, massive vulnerability, humour and a whole lot of “f*ck it, let’s do this.”
No perfect lives. No bullshit. Just real people telling the truth about what it takes to build a life that feels like your own.
Come get inspired. Then go LIVE!

title: Horizonte mit Stéphane Dähler
author: Stéphane Dähler
description:
Menschen. Reisen. Geschichten.
Von Costa Rica über die Schweiz bis nach Afrika. Inspirierende Gespräche über Reisen, Unternehmertum, soziale Projekte, Kulturen und die Geschichten, die uns verbinden. Neue Perspektiven für alle, die neugierig auf die Welt und ihre Menschen sind.

title: Flirting With Chaos 2
author: Giana
description: Just two friends gabbing about this crazy chaotic life.

title: Created by 3 TRUE Creepy Rainy Night Sca
author: 3 TRUE Creepy Rainy  Stories
description:
3 TRUE Creepy Rainy Night Scary Stories

Three chilling true stories set on dark, stormy nights when the rain wouldn’t stop and the streets felt strangely empty. From mysterious figures in the shadows to terrifying encounters that defy explanation, each story reveals how an ordinary rainy night can turn into a nightmare.

Real stories. Real fear. Are you brave enough to listen? 🌧️👻

description: Self-Improvement Reflections

title: Broken. Adjust. Heal...
author: Stephanie Shaffer
description:
Broken. Adjust. Heal...explores what happens after life breaks us open. Host Stephanie Shaffer, MSW, LCSW shares lessons from a lifetime of personal and professional experiences with grief, illness, trauma, and loss — including hospice work, surviving a cardiac arrest, and caregiving for her husband through four cancers. This podcast is about resilience, growth, and learning how to adjust to what we cannot change.
Be Resilient Institute presents Broken, Adjust, Heal...by Stephanie Shaffer.

title: Whispers to Sleep
author: Whispers to Sleep
description:
Whispers to Sleep 🌙

A gentle collection of calming stories, soothing melodies, and loving words designed to bring peace, comfort, and sweet dreams.

A quiet space where little hearts can relax, minds can slow down, and every night ends with a peaceful whisper: “Goodnight, sleep well, and dream beautifully.” ✨

title: God Within Life
author: Deborah Maurice
description: God in beauty, art, wonder; in the simple and mind-blowing; in the unraveling of every journey; God in the everyday.

title: The Soul Hearty Podcast
author: Beth Temple | Soul Hearty
description: Welcome to The Soul Hearty Podcast, hosted by Beth Temple. This is a space for the modern ritualist, the seeker, and the sovereign soul. Each week, we bridge the gap between our mental “open tabs” and intuitive magic—exploring the intersection of personal transformation, radical authenticity, and the daily rituals that ground us. Whether we’re diving into manifestation, relationship dynamics, or the art of claiming your power, this is your home for heart-centered, unfiltered growth. Dive into the ritual. Become the architect of your own sovereign life. Self-love is the transformation. 💜

title: The Business of Dog Grooming
author: Karen Fisher
description:
Welcome to the Business of Dog Grooming podcast with Karen Fisher, dog groomer, business strategist and founder of the Dog Grooming Business Academy.


This is the podcast for dog groomers who know success isn't measured by money alone. It's about loving the dogs you groom, working with clients who value and respect you, financial security and building a business that supports your life instead of consuming it.


If you're ready for honest business conversations and practical strategies that recognise what it's really like to work in your business as well as on it, you're in the right place.

title: Smalls and Bigs
author: Smalls and Bigs
description: One small dude chilling and talking with a tall dude.

title: Free to Disagree
author: The New Zealand Initiative
description: Free to Disagree is a weekly conversation about New Zealand politics and economics hosted by Oliver Hartwich and Damien Grant. Two friends on broadly the same side of politics who find plenty to disagree about anyway. Each week they discuss three big issues, leading up to the election. Produced by The New Zealand Initiative.

title: Beauty and the Beasts
author: Beauty and the Beasts
description: Welcome to Beauty & the Beasts — your girls' night sleepover for chilling real-life horror stories, urban legends, paranormal encounters and unexplained mysteries. Grab your favorite skincare, put on a face mask, do your makeup, and get comfortable while we dive into strange, unsettling and spine-tingling tales from around the world. Because who says you can't glow while getting goosebumps? ✨🖤 New horror stories every Tuesday & Friday.

title: In My Office with Corey Adamson
author: Corey Adamson
description:
Corey is a 34 year old real estate agent and business owner writing over $3 million GCI a year, and he's opening the door on what it actually takes to get there. Every second Wednesday he sits down with some of WA's best agents, including the number one agent in Western Australia, for honest conversations about listings, leadership, mindset and the business behind the business.
No scripts, no polish, just the conversations that usually stay behind closed doors.
New episodes every second Wednesday. Subscribe so you don't miss one, and follow along on TikTok and Instagram.

title: People With Disabilities Doin' Stuff
author: Kevin States & Joey Ellis
description: Meet with individuals with various disabilities to discuss their story, any barriers, advice, insight, and how they live their everyday lives.

title: Digital Respect
author: Possible
description: Digital respect means treating others with kindness, fairness, and consideration online. It involves using good manners, protecting personal privacy, avoiding cyberbullying, and recognizing the human being behind the screen.

title: The Big Dream Hotline
author: Megan · Big Mother Energy
description:
Hello friend — welcome to THE BIG DREAM HOTLINE, from Big Mother Energy.
This is the show for every mom who packed her dreams into a box marked "someday" and shoved it to the back of the closet. The bakery. The book. The business. The one-way ticket. The degree. We're getting the box back out.
Here's how it works: real moms call or text the hotline — (914) 340-4611 — and say their wildest dream out loud, some for the first time ever. Then host Megan plays it on the show, becomes the loudest person in their corner, finds the first step they can take THIS week, and dares them to take it. Deadlines included. Follow-ups guaranteed.
Because a dream that stays in your head isn't a plan — it's a secret. And you've been carrying yours long enough.
No dream too big. No dream too "silly." One rule: you have to say it out loud.
New episodes weekly. Bring your dream. 📞
Got a dream? Call or text the hotline: (914) 340-4611. (Messages may be played and lightly edited on the show.)
#BigDreamEnergy — Say it out loud, mama.

title: Prisoner of Hope
author: Liz Karnavar / Prisoner of Hope
description:
Welcome to Prisoner of Hope. 
My name is Liz Karnavar, and this channel is about my personal journey through abuse, deep tragedy, profound loss and the valuable life lessons I have learned along the way. 
I share my story not to dwell on the past, but to show that a beautiful future is still possible.
If you are searching for comfort, healing, or proof that you can make it through the storm, you belong here. 
Even in our darkest moments, hope can hold us captive.

title: Little Italy Podcast & Little Italy of LA Podcast
author: Deborah Zara Kobylt
description: Little Italy Podcast & Little Italy of LA Podcast celebrate Italians & Italian Americans contributing to art, culture, science, travel, community, and so much more throughout the U.S., Los Angeles, and beyond. Created and hosted by Deborah Zara Kobylt, award-winning journalist and proud Italian American living in Los Angeles, who grew up in NJ, NY, and Fla.

title: Town Stories
author: SM Media
description: Every town has a story—and the best ones are told by the people who live them. Town Stories gives everyday people a mic to share their personal journeys, local lore, and life lessons. Real people, real lives, and the stories that connect us all.

title: Echo Pages
author: Roysibel Annabel
description: Echoed Pages — Podcast DescriptionEchoed Pages is a place where stories come alive through the power of sound.Step into a world of captivating stories, timeless books, and unforgettable characters—brought to life through immersive narration. Whether you’re looking for inspiration, adventure, knowledge, or simply a quiet moment to escape, Echoed Pages invites you to listen, imagine, and experience every chapter in a new way.Turn the page. Close your eyes. Let the story echo.

title: Fumbled Justice
author: Paul Del Pizzo
description:
In 1994, Eric Naposki was investigated for murder — and cleared. In 2011, he was convicted of that same murder, sentenced to life without parole, and denied the right to use the evidence that once set him free.

Now, for the first time, Eric speaks out from prison.

Fumbled Justice is the podcast that gives him that platform — episode by episode, in his own words. Follow now and hear the case the jury never did.
